description: Sends input from the customer to a checkout task that is paused and waiting for it (only for tasks created with options.allowInteraction = true). Currently the only supported input is an MFA/OTP code (intent 'mfa'). Ask the customer for the code they received, then submit it here. An OTP can only be submitted once per task.

intent.description: Type of input being sent. Supported: 'mfa'. Default: 'mfa'

taskId.description: ID of the checkout task that is waiting for input

name: send_interactive_inputs
